dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible perimeters exhibit high-frequency serrated or 'scribbled' light-colored geometries forming irregular closed and semi-closed loops. Transition occurs as a sharp gradient from high-intensity light edges to a uniform dark low-intensity interior.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of small, solid high-intensity pixel clusters without internal gradients, primarily concentrated in the inter-annular spaces on the upper dorsal and right lateral surfaces.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest rings on the upper left flank form an obtuse scalene triangle, with the longest axis oriented approximately 45 degrees to the visible spinal midline.
